newsitem.title: BURMA: Buddhist monks desecrate mosque in Rangoon.
newsitem.headline: Buddhist monks desecrate mosque in Rangoon.

text.p: A group of about 50 Buddhist monks desecrated a Moslem mosque in the northeastern quarter of the Burmese capital on Saturday, eyewitnesses told Reuters. The monks threw stones and used sticks to hit scaffolding and windows of the mosque, which was under renovation, they said. Police dispersed the monks after the incident, which lasted several minutes. The unrest was the first of its kind in Rangoon, and came soon after Buddhist-Moslem strife broke out in Burma's second city Mandalay, where a curfew has been in force since last weekend.
"About fifty monks arrived in cars at the mosque in Kanbe, where they struck the mosque with sticks and stones," one eyewitness said.
Police arrived about twenty minutes later and the monks left the scene, the witnesses added.
No arrests were made, but the authorities imposed tight security in the area round the mosque, they said.
Buddhist monks in Mandalay last weekend rioted and attacked mosques there after a report that a young Buddhist girl had been raped by a Moslem man, government sources and diplomats said.
